subject: Security onboarding checkpoints & evidence commitments (Valora Bank)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valorabank.com>, security_ops@valorabank.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Security onboarding checkpoints & evidence commitments (Valora Bank)

Hi Liam / Valora security team —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned while your infosec review runs in parallel with procurement. High-level takeaways from our call: 

- Primary risk areas you flagged: audit log retention and access controls for customer data stores; SOC 2 scope for the hosted API surface; and pen-test cadence/attestation for our dedicated deployment.
- Business goal: enable a constrained pilot (prod-like data, limited traffic) by mid-January to validate latency and retention behavior.
- Minimal acceptance criteria you asked for: SOC 2 or equivalent controls map + evidence for logging, proof of data residency options, and a pen-test plan with timing.

Proposed owners & next actions (with tentative due dates):
1) Preliminary evidence inventory (what we can share immediately) — Owner: Priyom — Due: 2027-11-30. See attached "prelim-evidence-index.csv".
2) Dataflow and residency diagram + retention defaults — Owner: Kimberly — Due: 2027-12-03. Attachment: "redwood-dataflow-diagram.png".
3) SOC 2 scoped services and controls map (high level) — Owner: Ben — Due: 2027-12-06. Attachment: "soc2-scoped-services.pdf".
4) Draft pen-test scope (what we propose to run on pilot infra) — Owner: Redwood Security Eng — Draft by: 2027-12-08; final schedule after your confirmation.

Immediate asks for Valora:
- Please confirm what minimum retention window you need for audit logs (e.g., 90 days vs 1 year).
- Any hard requirements on encryption-at-rest KMS provider or HSM?
- Preferred window for a live pen-test (Dec vs Jan) so we can align scope.

I attached the initial evidence index and the dataflow diagram. We can redact any pieces you prefer prior to sharing with procurement/legal.

I'll follow up with the SOC 2 summary and a pen-test-scope draft from Kimberly by next week.

Thanks — look forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: prelim-evidence-index.csv (csv), redwood-dataflow-diagram.png (png), soc2-scoped-services.pdf (pdf)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valorabank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@valorabank.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Security onboarding checkpoints & evidence commitments (Valora Bank)

Thanks, Priyom — useful summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

On Fri, Nov 27, 2027 at 09:15 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Primary risk areas you flagged: audit log retention and access controls for customer data stores; SOC 2 scope for the hosted API surface; and pen-test cadence/attestation for our dedicated deployment.

A few items to confirm:
- Retention: We need a baseline of 1 year for audit logs for the pilot (this is non-negotiable for our compliance team). If you have archival options that meet GDPR/data residency constraints, that helps.
- Residency: Valora will require EU-only residency for pilot customers; please call out regions that map to that (we are targeting Dublin + Frankfurt).
- Pen-test: We prefer a vendor-neutral approach; can you share a draft scope and whether Redwood will coordinate or if we should bring our own vendor. We also need to understand whether findings are tracked in a shared Jira/issue tracker.

If you can confirm those three points and share the draft pen-test scope as discussed, we can push procurement & legal to schedule the DPA review.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security, Valora Bank
liam.oconnor@valorabank.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security onboarding checkpoints & evidence commitments (Valora Bank)

Priyom / Ben —

Thanks for the recap. Quick answers to Valora's asks and next pieces I'm attaching: "pen-test-scope-draft.docx" (high level).

- Retention: We can offer a 1-year audit log retention for the Valora pilot. Default live retention is 90 days; we will push older logs to encrypted archival storage in the EU region (Dublin) with snapshot-level indexing for search. We will document deletion workflows in the controls map.
- Residency: We will pin pilot workloads to EU-only regions (Dublin or Frankfurt). For private/dedicated deployments we support customer-controlled VPCs and KMS keys.
- Pen-test coordination: Redwood can coordinate and run the initial test with our partners (we have longstanding engagements with three approved vendors). We will also accept customer-procured vendors; in that case we will provide a scope, temporary access windows, and remediation targets. All findings can be tracked in a shared Jira project (we will create a triage board and invite Valora contacts).

Next actions I'm taking this week:
1) Attach pen-test-scope-draft.docx for your review (Priyom, Ben) — I'll update with Valora's preference.
2) Produce a short controls playbook for retention + KMS choices by 2027-12-03.
3) Prepare an exportable evidence bundle (redact-friendly) for procurement by 2027-12-01.

Let me know if you want me to join the procurement/DPA call.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachment: pen-test-scope-draft.docx (docx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@valorabank.com>, security_ops@valorabank.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security onboarding checkpoints & evidence commitments (Valora Bank)

Liam — thanks for the quick confirmation. Confirming actions and logistics below so legal/procurement have what they need.

- Retention: Redwood confirms 1-year audit-log retention for the pilot. We will document export/deletion workflows in the controls playbook.
- Residency: Pilot will be pinned to EU region (Dublin). We will include a region statement in the DPA draft.
- Pen-test: Kimberly attached the draft scope; Redwood is happy to coordinate with our vendor or accept Valora's vendor. Proposed test window: Jan 10–14 (allows us time to complete CCR and evidence handoff in December). Please confirm if that works.

Immediate deliverables we will upload to a shared drive and link into the HubSpot record:
- Prelim evidence index (done)
- Dataflow diagram (done)
- SOC 2 high-level services map (in progress)
- Pen-test scope draft (attached)

I'll circulate a short invite for a 30-min procurement + security sync next week (suggested times: Wed 12/1 10:00–10:30 or Thu 12/2 15:00–15:30 CET). We'll also open a HubSpot task and a DocuSign envelope for DPA signature routing (links below).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/VAL-2345
Shared drive note: https://docs.redwood.com/drive/valora-onboarding-note
DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.example/VAL-2345-SLA

If that schedule looks good, we'll finalize dates and owners.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com
